segments.approved_text: AI can copy software, undercut margins, replace employees, help foreign actors to overthrow your CEO. But... They can't print more Bitcoin.
So over time, I came to the conclusion that real estate will most likely replace or will be replaced. So real estate will most likely... be replaced by Bitcoin in its function as a savings account.

Like, I want every single person. I've said this multiple times on this show. I want every single person that has ever watched Simply Bitcoin that hangs out with me in the live chat to eventually come up to be and be like, thank you. I am a better person because of this. Not just a richer person. I mean a better person.
